hunks.baseline: That one sentence I’d heard the day before wouldn’t leave my mind.
hunks.sol: Those words from the day before wouldn’t leave my mind.

hunks.baseline: I sat in the caregiver’s chair beside the bed, staring blankly at the humidifier spraying mist. Then a thought suddenly occurred to me, and I said it aloud.
hunks.sol: I sat in the caregiver’s chair beside the bed, staring blankly at the humidifier spraying mist. Then a thought occurred to me, and I said it aloud.

hunks.baseline: Bloodshed was commonplace, and death was part of daily life. Might made right, and the survivors were the winners.
hunks.sol: Bloodshed was commonplace, and death was part of daily life. Might made right, and whoever survived was the winner.

hunks.baseline: Whenever I witnessed the cruel side of Murim, I thought of the modern world.
hunks.sol: Whenever I witnessed Murim’s cruelty, I thought of the modern world.

hunks.baseline: People who wrapped themselves in expensive clothes and wholesome images before ruling over the concrete jungle. The moment those bastards began drawing the daggers hidden in their sleeves, they became the monsters outside the Gates.
hunks.sol: People wrapped in expensive clothes and wholesome public images who ruled over the concrete jungle. The moment those bastards began drawing the daggers hidden in their sleeves, they revealed themselves as the monsters outside the Gates.

hunks.baseline: I had been thinking too softly about things. Even though I knew the world was unfair and fucked-up, I hadn’t been able to let go of my complacency.
hunks.sol: I’d been too soft in my thinking. Even though I knew the world was unfair and fucked-up, I hadn’t been able to let go of my complacency.

hunks.baseline: There might be a vicious struggle to prove one’s abilities, but I had believed something like today’s incident couldn’t happen.
hunks.sol: There might be a vicious struggle to prove one’s abilities, but I’d believed something like this could never happen here.

hunks.baseline: He probably wouldn’t have much trouble with daily life, but I couldn’t guarantee his return as a Hunter. Potions weren’t a cure-all.
hunks.sol: He probably wouldn’t have much trouble with daily life, but there was no guarantee he could return as a Hunter. Potions weren’t a cure-all.

hunks.baseline: Various thoughts swam through my cold mind.
hunks.sol: Questions circled through my cold, clear mind.

hunks.baseline: Who had sent the Black Hunters, and why? What was their purpose?
hunks.sol: Who had sent the Black Hunters, and why? What were they after?

hunks.baseline: Cutting off Im Kkeokjeong’s arms could have been a warning to stop here. Or it could have been the signal announcing the beginning.
hunks.sol: Cutting off Im Kkeokjeong’s arms could have been a warning to stop here. Or it could have been the opening shot.

hunks.baseline: I had just pulled the disordered blanket over Im Kkeokjeong when—
hunks.sol: I had just pulled the rumpled blanket over Im Kkeokjeong when—

hunks.baseline: Along with the vibration, a smartphone lit up the darkness.
hunks.sol: A vibration broke the silence, and my smartphone lit up the darkness.

hunks.baseline: It was a short text message from Team Leader Choi.
hunks.sol: A short text message from Team Leader Choi.

hunks.baseline: > **Team Leader Choi:** To the Guild House.
hunks.sol: > **Team Leader Choi:** Come to the Guild House.

hunks.baseline: I left the hospital as soon as I read the message. It was deep into the night, and two people were waiting for me at the Guild House, where everyone else had already gone home.
hunks.sol: I left the hospital as soon as I read the message. It was the dead of night, and two people were waiting for me at the Guild House after everyone else had gone home.

hunks.baseline: Butler Kim, whom I had naturally expected to be there, was nowhere to be seen.
hunks.sol: Butler Kim, whom I’d naturally expected to be there, was nowhere to be seen.

hunks.baseline: “He’s stepped away for a moment.”
hunks.sol: “He stepped out for a moment.”

hunks.baseline: It was unusual to see Butler Kim absent from Team Leader Choi’s side, where he had always stood like a shadow. But that wasn’t important right now.
hunks.sol: It was unusual for Butler Kim to leave Team Leader Choi’s side when he usually followed him like a shadow, but that wasn’t important right now.

hunks.baseline: I skipped straight to the point.
hunks.sol: I got straight to the point.

hunks.baseline: “I should offer you a cup of coffee before I explain, but… Take a look at this first.”
hunks.sol: “I should offer you a cup of coffee before I explain, but… take a look at this first.”

hunks.baseline: His long finger tapped an internet article, and a stream of articles divided into different categories appeared.
hunks.sol: His long finger tapped the news section, bringing up a stream of articles divided by category.

hunks.baseline: Among them, I skimmed the article at the very top.
hunks.sol: I skimmed the headlines at the very top.

hunks.baseline:
> [The Judiciary Bows Before the Fame the Public Has Created. Where Is the Fairness?]
>
> [United Party Supreme Council Member Assemblywoman Yoon Seoyoon: “A Death Brought About by One Individual’s Rash Actions. Won Myunghoon Should Have Faced the Judgment of the Law.” Strong Condemnation…]
>
> [Self-Defense or Murder?]
hunks.sol:
> [The Judiciary Bows to Fame Manufactured by the Public. Where Is the Fairness?]
>
> [United Party Supreme Council Member and Assemblywoman Yoon Seoyoon Strongly Condemns Incident: “A Death Caused by One Individual’s Rash Actions. Won Myunghoon Should Have Faced the Judgment of the Law.”]
>
> [Self-Defense or Murder?]

hunks.baseline: Articles filling the politics and society sections. They didn’t include my name, but it was obvious who they were talking about.
hunks.sol: The articles dominated the politics and society sections. They didn’t mention my name, but it was obvious who they were talking about.

hunks.baseline: “When was this posted?”
hunks.sol: “When were these posted?”

hunks.baseline: “An hour ago. And it already has over a hundred thousand views and more than five thousand comments.”
hunks.sol: “An hour ago. They already have over a hundred thousand views and more than five thousand comments.”

hunks.baseline: “Apparently, netizens are more diligent than we thought. Or should I say the paid commenters?”
hunks.sol: “Apparently, netizens are more diligent than we thought. Or perhaps I should say the paid commenters are.”

hunks.baseline: “Scroll down a little. It’ll be more than you expected, Taekyung.”
hunks.sol: “Scroll down a little. It’ll exceed even your expectations.”

hunks.baseline: I stared silently at the headline in bold.
hunks.sol: I stared silently at the bold headline.

hunks.baseline: > [Exclusive Interview with Former Colleague K to Be Released Early: “Famous Hunter J Is an Ugly Human Being.”]
hunks.sol: > [Exclusive Preview of Interview with Former Colleague K: “Famous Hunter J Is a Vile Human Being.”]

hunks.baseline: When I tapped the article, a preview video of an interview lasting just over three minutes appeared. After a fifteen-second advertisement for a luxury cosmetics brand, the screen filled with the image of a potbellied man in a carefully tailored suit.
hunks.sol: When I tapped the article, a three-minute preview of the interview began playing. After a fifteen-second advertisement for a luxury cosmetics brand, a potbellied man in a sharp suit filled the screen.

hunks.baseline: There was a small amount of mosaic blurring over his face, but I recognized him at a glance.
hunks.sol: His face had been lightly pixelated, but I recognized him at a glance.

hunks.baseline: When I realized the identity of the middle-aged man—or rather, “former colleague K”—a hollow laugh escaped me.
hunks.sol: The moment I realized who the middle-aged man—or rather, “former colleague K”—was, a hollow laugh escaped me.

hunks.baseline: It was an all-too-familiar face. Someone I had thought I would never see again was right there on the screen.
hunks.sol: That face was all too familiar. Someone I’d thought I would never see again was right there on the screen.

hunks.baseline: Song Song, who had been looking at the phone over my shoulder, asked,
hunks.sol: Song Song, looking at the phone over my shoulder, asked, “You really know him?”

hunks.baseline: “You really know him?”
What word could describe the relationship between that man and me? I thought about it carefully before opening my mouth.
hunks.sol: What word could describe the relationship between that man and me? I thought about it for a moment before answering.

hunks.baseline: No matter how I thought about it, those words fit perfectly.
hunks.sol: No matter how I looked at it, those words fit perfectly.

hunks.baseline: Our relationship had been that terrible. Considering everything we had been through together, it was almost strange that we had never crossed blades.
hunks.sol: Our relationship had been that terrible. Considering everything that had happened between us, it was almost strange that no one had ever pulled a knife.

hunks.baseline: When I had been an F-rank Hunter, he had been the one who goaded the Guild Master into firing me.
hunks.sol: Back when I was an F-rank Hunter, he had been the one who goaded the Guild Master into firing me.

hunks.baseline: The last time I’d seen him was when I ran into him at the Association while going through a Grade reassessment. And now, I was seeing him again like this.
hunks.sol: The last time I’d seen him was when I ran into him at the Association while getting my Grade reassessed. And now, here he was again.

hunks.baseline: *I heard he was fired from the Guild afterward.*
hunks.sol: *I heard he got fired from the Guild afterward.*

hunks.baseline: Kim Sangshik was a man with no ability and endless greed. Despite his name, he lacked common sense, too, and had been fired after committing every kind of idiotic blunder imaginable.
hunks.sol: Kim Sangshik was short on ability and overflowing with greed. Despite his name, he was short on common sense, too. He’d gone around doing every idiotic thing imaginable until the Guild finally fired him.

hunks.baseline: He was practically the very definition of a petty little man, so it was obvious that he had been grinding his teeth at me ever since.
hunks.sol: He was the very definition of a petty little man, so there was no doubt he’d been grinding his teeth at the thought of me ever since.

hunks.baseline: That was probably why he had even filmed an interview like this.
hunks.sol: That was probably why he’d agreed to an interview like this.

hunks.baseline: As it happened, the reporter’s questions began playing on the video.
hunks.sol: Right on cue, the reporter began asking questions.

hunks.baseline: “‘I hear you have something to say about the recently famous Hunter J. First of all, is it true that you were his former colleague?’”
hunks.sol: “I hear you have something to say about the recently famous Hunter J. First, is it true that you were his former colleague?”

hunks.baseline: Kim Sangshik nodded with an unusually serious expression.
hunks.sol: Kim Sangshik nodded with an uncharacteristically serious expression.

hunks.baseline: “‘That is absolutely true. I was Jin Tae… No, J’s immediate supervisor.’”
hunks.sol: “That is absolutely true. I was Jin Tae… No, I was J’s direct supervisor.”

hunks.baseline: “‘More precisely?’”
hunks.sol: “More specifically?”

hunks.baseline: “‘He was a member of my team. I became team leader after the Gate accident two years ago. I was also the one who notified J of his dismissal this summer.’”
hunks.sol: “He was on my team. I became team leader after the Gate accident two years ago. I was also the one who informed J of his dismissal this summer.”

hunks.baseline: “‘Oh dear. Was there a reason?’”
hunks.sol: “Oh dear. Was there a reason?”

hunks.baseline: “‘There wasn’t just one reason.’”
hunks.sol: “There wasn’t just one.”

hunks.baseline: After that, Kim Sangshik launched into an indignant tirade about why he had fired me.
hunks.sol: Kim Sangshik then launched into an indignant tirade about why he had fired me.

hunks.baseline: Every single excuse was a gem of bullshit, but his final exchange with the reporter was the crowning touch.
hunks.sol: Every word was pure, undiluted bullshit, but his final exchange with the reporter was the crowning touch.

hunks.baseline: “‘I was falsely accused of employment corruption and driven out of the Guild where I had worked for more than twenty years. But I did not fire J for any personal gain.’”
hunks.sol: “I was falsely accused of employment corruption and driven out of the Guild where I had worked for more than twenty years. But I did not fire J for personal gain.”

hunks.baseline: “‘Are you saying there was another reason?’”
hunks.sol: “Are you saying there was another reason?”
“Yes.”

hunks.baseline: There had been a reason they had released only a three-minute preview. Kim Sangshik ended it with the solemn expression of a martyr for the nation.
hunks.sol: Now I understood why they had released this three-minute preview. Kim Sangshik brought it to a dramatic close with the grim expression of a martyr sacrificing himself for his country.

hunks.baseline: “‘During the mutated Gate accident two years ago, J threw his teammates to the monsters as prey and fled. He is the kind of man who won’t hesitate to do any ugly and dirty thing to survive…’”
hunks.sol: “During the mutated Gate accident two years ago, J threw his teammates to the monsters as bait and fled. He’s the kind of man who won’t hesitate to commit any vile, disgusting act to survive…”

hunks.baseline: I couldn’t properly hear what came after that.
hunks.sol: I barely heard what came after that.

hunks.baseline: Even after the video ended with a caption promising that the full interview would be released soon, I continued staring at the screen in silence.
hunks.sol: Even after the video ended with a caption promising that the full interview would be released soon, I continued staring silently at the screen.

hunks.baseline: As if Kim Sangshik might leap out of it if I kept watching long enough.
hunks.sol: As if Kim Sangshik might leap out of it if I stared long enough.

hunks.baseline: “How did you find it?”
hunks.sol: “What did you think?”

hunks.baseline: Ah, how did I find it?
hunks.sol: Ah, what did I think?

hunks.baseline: Well. The back of my head felt numb, and part of me wanted to laugh. At the same time, my lower stomach was boiling.
hunks.sol: Well. I felt like I’d been clubbed in the back of the head, but part of me wanted to laugh. At the same time, something was boiling in my gut.

hunks.baseline: “It’s very interesting. Just like you said, Team Leader.”
hunks.sol: “Very interesting. Just like you said, Team Leader.”

hunks.baseline: “I laughed when I first saw it, too. I know roughly what kind of person the K in the interview is—or rather, the man named Kim Sangshik. The problem is…”
hunks.sol: “I laughed when I first saw it, too. I have a rough idea of what K—or rather, Kim Sangshik—is like. The problem is…”

hunks.baseline: There were more than ten thousand comments now, and I didn’t need to read them all. One of the most upvoted comments caught my eye.
hunks.sol: There were more than ten thousand comments now, and I didn’t need to read them all. The most upvoted comment caught my eye.

hunks.baseline:
> **(Best comment)** I knew this was coming. I heard it across the bridge[^1] and thought, *No way,* but I had a feeling it would blow up someday.
>
> [^1]: A Korean expression meaning the information was heard indirectly.
hunks.sol: > **(Best comment)** I knew it. I heard it through the grapevine and thought, *No way,* but I always had a feeling this would blow up someday.

hunks.baseline: *What bridge? And what the hell is supposed to blow up?*
hunks.sol: *What vine? And what the hell is supposed to blow up?*

hunks.baseline: I didn’t know what kind of asshole had written it, but it was a relief he wasn’t standing in front of me.
hunks.sol: I didn’t know what kind of asshole had written it, but he was lucky he wasn’t standing in front of me.

hunks.baseline: If he had been, I would have made sure that at the very least, he heard the next rumor from the overpass to the Yellow Springs.
hunks.sol: If he had been, I would’ve made sure he heard the next piece of gossip from across the overpass to the Yellow Springs.

hunks.baseline: Team Leader Choi took back his smartphone, folded his arms loosely, and spoke.
hunks.sol: Team Leader Choi took back his smartphone, loosely folded his arms, and spoke.

hunks.baseline: “This is organized. It’s clear now that sending the Black Hunters was part of the plan from the beginning.”
hunks.sol: “This is organized. It’s clear now that they planned to send the Black Hunters from the very beginning.”

hunks.baseline: “And they’re the ones creating the hostile public opinion, too.”
hunks.sol: “And they’re the ones stirring up public outrage, too.”

hunks.baseline: “That’s how people are. Once someone really starts muddying the waters, it’s hard for people to keep their bearings.”
hunks.sol: “That’s how people are. Once someone starts muddying the waters in earnest, it’s hard to keep your bearings.”

hunks.baseline: “And I doubt there will be even a single line in the news about Uncle Kkeokjeong being attacked in the middle of all this.”
hunks.sol: “And I doubt there’ll be so much as a single line in the news about Uncle Kkeokjeong being attacked.”

hunks.baseline: “If I didn’t, I’d be a fucking idiot. Did the investigation team handling the case say anything?”
hunks.sol: “If I didn’t, I’d be a fucking idiot. Has the investigation team handling the case said anything?”

hunks.baseline: Team Leader Choi slowly shook his head.
hunks.sol: Team Leader Choi shook his head slightly.

hunks.baseline: “There seems to be outside pressure. The CCTV footage is in the other side’s hands, too.”
hunks.sol: “There appears to be outside pressure. The CCTV footage is already in the other side’s hands.”

hunks.baseline: A sound like bones shifting out of place came from my clenched fist, which had tightened without me realizing it.
hunks.sol: My fist clenched without me realizing it, and my knuckles cracked.

hunks.baseline: “They’re really coming at us with a plan.”
hunks.sol: “They’ve planned this down to the last detail.”

hunks.baseline: We weren’t dealing with some Third Rate media company that sold gossip.
hunks.sol: We weren’t dealing with some Third Rate media company that made its money selling gossip.

hunks.baseline: This was one of the country’s ten largest major media outlets.
hunks.sol: This was one of the country’s ten largest media outlets.

hunks.baseline: They would wrap even the most ludicrous bullshit in attractive packaging and broadcast it convincingly. Along the way, they would use money and power to bolster its credibility.
hunks.sol: They would wrap even the most ludicrous bullshit in glossy packaging and present it as credible. Then they would use money and power to lend it even more weight.

hunks.baseline: “We’ll get to see the faces of my old coworkers again. Though I guess it’ll be hard to recognize them if they’re shown with their faces mosaicked.”
hunks.sol: “Looks like I’ll get to see my old coworkers again. Though I guess they’ll be hard to recognize once their faces are pixelated.”

hunks.baseline: I asked Team Leader Choi, who was looking at me with an unreadable expression,
hunks.sol: Team Leader Choi was looking at me strangely.

hunks.baseline: “As I recall, Jin Taekyung had a good reputation within the Sopung Guild.”
hunks.sol: “As I recall, you had a good reputation within the Sopung Guild.”

hunks.baseline: “Then why did you think that?”
hunks.sol: “Then why would you expect them to turn on you?”

hunks.baseline: “Because there’s one thing that works on everyone. This. And this.”
hunks.sol: “Because there’s one thing that works on just about everyone. This. You know.”

hunks.baseline: I brought my thumb and index finger together and wiggled them.
hunks.sol: I brought my thumb and index finger together and rubbed them.

hunks.baseline: In the end, it came down to money. Money was everything.
hunks.sol: In the end, it all came down to cash. Money was everything.

hunks.baseline: For Hunters who were willing to risk their lives to make money, the temptation would be even stronger.
hunks.sol: And for Hunters who risked their lives to make money, the temptation would be even stronger.

hunks.baseline: “Maybe it’s because I’ve been blindsided so many times in a row, but… These were people I’d spent seven years laughing and joking around with. And I still can’t trust them.”
hunks.sol: “Maybe it’s because I’ve been stabbed in the back so many times in a row, but… these are people I spent seven years laughing and joking around with, and I still can’t trust them.”

hunks.baseline: If this had happened a few days ago, I might have naively believed in my old coworkers.
hunks.sol: A few days ago, I might have naively believed in my old coworkers.

hunks.baseline: But not now. The world where dreams, friendship, and common sense meant anything had already vanished from my mind.
hunks.sol: But not anymore. The world where dreams, friendship, and common sense meant anything had already vanished from my mind.

hunks.baseline: “Looking at how the article made it into the politics and society section, it seems like they greased some lawmaker’s palm, too. You think they couldn’t buy off a few low-rank Hunters who are struggling to make ends meet?”
hunks.sol: “Judging by those articles in the politics and society sections, it looks like they’ve greased some lawmaker’s palm, too. You think they couldn’t buy off a few low-rank Hunters struggling to make ends meet?”

hunks.baseline: “It’s obvious. I’ll become the worst bastard alive, get carved up all over the internet, and be torn apart. The image I’ve built up until now will come crashing down, and our Guild will come crashing down with it.”
hunks.sol: “It’s obvious. I’ll become the most despicable bastard alive and get torn to pieces online. The reputation I’ve built will come crashing down, and our Guild will come crashing down with it.”

hunks.baseline: Team Leader Choi, who had been wearing a strange expression the entire time, let out a quiet laugh.
hunks.sol: Team Leader Choi, who had been wearing that strange expression the entire time, let out a quiet laugh.

hunks.baseline: “You’ve improved a little. You can think like a jaded adult now.”
hunks.sol: “You’ve improved a little. You’re finally capable of thinking like a jaded adult.”

hunks.baseline: “I’ll decide after I see what you do from this point on.”
hunks.sol: “I’ll decide after I see what you do from here.”

hunks.baseline: “We can’t just stand there and let them do this to us.”
hunks.sol: “We can’t just stand by and let them do this to us.”

hunks.baseline: As he spoke, his finger pressed the screen of his smartphone. A ringing tone sounded, and someone answered.
hunks.sol: As he spoke, he tapped his smartphone screen. The phone rang, and someone answered.

hunks.baseline: Butler Kim’s low, smooth voice flowed through the speaker.
hunks.sol: Butler Kim’s low, smooth voice flowed from the speaker.
